 JUDGMENT 1.

sentences.text: The allegation of respondent No.2 - complainant that this appellant - accused No.1 and respondent No.2 had love affair and this appellant - accused No.1 promising to marry her, had sexual intercourse with her.

Thereafter, the marriage of respondent No.2 has taken place with accused No.3 and this appellant - accused No.1 intimated accused No.3 of his love affair with the victim girl and therefore, accused No.3 left respondent No.2 in her house.

Thereafter, when the victim girl approached this appellant - accused No.1, he promised to marry her and had sexual intercourse and thereafter, parents of the victim girl NC: 2024:KHC:20331 approached parents of the appellant - accused No.1.
They refused to perform the marriage of the victim girl with their son, saying that they belongs to Lingayath Caste and the victim girl belongs to the Schedule Caste.
A case in Cr.No.89/2023 came to be registered against the appellant - accused No.1 in Kodihalli Police Station, for the aforesaid offences.
The appellant - accused No.1 came to be arrested in the month of August, 2023 and he is in judicial custody.

4. Now, the charge sheet has been filed against this appellant - accused No.1 for the offences under Sections 504 and 376 of IPC, Sections 4 and 6 of the POCSO Act and Sections 9, 10 and 11 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006.
This appellant - accused No.1 has filed Crl.Misc.No.717/2023 under Section 439 of Cr.P.C, seeking bail and the same came to be rejected by the impugned order which is challenged in this appeal.

Learned counsel for the appellant - accused No.1 would contend that the victim girl's marriage has taken place with accused No.3 on 21.05.2023 and therefore, this appellant - accused No.1 has refused to marry her.

He further contended that now the charge sheet is filed and this appellant - accused No.1 is not required for the custodial interrogation and the offences alleged against the appellant - accused No.1 is a matter for trial and with this, he prayed to allow the appeal.
6.

Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1 - State would contend that statement of the victim girl recoded by the police under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, would clearly indicate that this appellant - accused No.1 had sexual intercourse with the victim girl who was below the age of 18 years.
The doctor who examined the victim girl has noted that her hymen is not intact and opined that she is used to act like that of sexual intercourse.
The charge sheet material show prima facie case against this appellant - accused No.1 for the offences NC: 2024:KHC:20331 alleged against him.
With this, he prayed to dismiss the appeal.
7. Having heard the learned counsel, the Court has perused the impugned order and the charge sheet records.

8. On perusal of the averments of the complaint, the statement of the victim girl recorded by the police under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, it is clear that the victim girl is aged more than 17 years and she had love affair with this appellant - accused No.1.

The victim girl has also stated that she had sexual Sri Rudresh vs State Of Karnataka on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64920222/
3 intercourse with this appellant - accused No.1.

sentences.text: The victim girl's marriage has taken place with accused No.3 on 21.05.2023.
Accused No.3 who is husband of the victim girl left her as this appellant - accused No.1 told him about his love affair with the victim girl.
The victim girl was aged more than 17 years as on the date of the alleged offence and she was aware of the consequences of her acts.

Whether this appellant - accused No.1 has committed any offence as alleged NC:
2024:KHC:20331 against him is the matter for trail.
Now, as the charge sheet is filed, the appellant - accused No.1 is not required for the custodial interrogation.

Without considering these aspects,
learned Sessions Judge has passed the impugned order which requires interference by this Court.

In the result, the following;
ORDER
The appeal is allowed.
The impugned order dated 14.09.2023 passed in Crl.Misc.No.717/2023 by the I Additional District and Sessions Judge, Ramanagara is set-aside.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Crl.Misc.No.717/2023 filed by this appellant - accused No.1 is allowed.
The appellant - accused No.1 is granted bail in Crime No.89/2023 of Kodihalli Police Station, subject to the following conditions:

(i) The appellant - accused No.1 shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rupees one lakh only), with one surety for the likesum to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
(ii) The appellant - accused No.1 shall not threaten the complainant and the other prosecution witnesses.
NC: 2024:KHC:20331 (iii) The appellant - accused No.1 shall appear before the Trial Court on all dates of hearing, unless exempted and co-operate in speedy disposal of the case.
